Natural, High-Quality Jerky Treats Your Dog Will Love

If you’re looking for healthy dog jerky treats in Taunton, Massachusetts, you’ve come to the right place. Our local retail store specializes in high-quality, protein-packed jerky treats for dogs, made with simple ingredients and irresistible flavor. Whether you’re training, rewarding, or just spoiling your pup (no judgment ), we’ve got treats your dog will go crazy for.

Why Choose Our Dog Jerky Treats?

Not all dog treats are created equal. That’s why we focus on quality, transparency, and taste.

  • Real meat ingredients – no fillers or mystery additives

  • Grain-free options available

  • Great for training, rewards, or everyday treating

  • Sourced from trusted suppliers with safety in mind

  • Suitable for dogs of all sizes and breeds

Our jerky treats are slowly dried to lock in flavor and nutrients, making them a healthier alternative to overly processed snacks.

A Local Pet Store Taunton Dog Owners Trust

We’re proud to be a locally owned pet treat store in Taunton, MA, serving dog lovers throughout Bristol County and nearby communities. When you shop with us, you’re supporting a local business that truly cares about dogs and the people who love them.

Need help choosing the right treat for your pup? We’re always happy to make recommendations based on your dog’s size, age, or dietary needs.

Perfect for Training, Rewards, and Happy Tails

Our dog jerky treats are:

  • Easy to break into training-size pieces

  • Packed with flavor dogs crave

  • A great high-value reward for good behavior

From puppies learning the basics to senior dogs who deserve a little extra love, our treats fit every stage of life.

Free 1 Hour Curbside Pick Up

Monday Route Truck

Orders must be placed by Saturday at 6 pm to make it on the Monday Route Truck. All order after that time will be on the following week's route.

All local deliveries will be tailgate/front door deliveries. Your order will be left at the closest point to your front door that is easily accessible for our truck & driver. You may be asked to sign for your order. We are not responsible for damaged or theft of orders after they are delivered to you.

Weekly Martha's Vineyard Delivery

Martha's Vineyard Delivery applies to purchases of $100 or more. This shipping option will only be applicable to customers with delivery addresses within the list of zip codes provided. Orders will ship on our Martha's Vineyard Route Truck that delivers weekly. Please contact us for delivery day.

Zip codes that qualify for Weekly Martha's Vineyard Delivery are - 02535,02539,02557,02568,02575.

All Martha's Vineyard deliveries will be tailgate/front door deliveries. Your order will be left at the closest point to your front door that is easily accessible for our truck & driver. You may be asked to sign for your order. We are not responsible for damaged or theft of orders after they are delivered to you.

UPS & USPS Orders

Most orders received by 12pm EST are processed and shipped out via UPS or USPS by the end of the next business day from our store in Taunton, MA. Orders received after 12pm EST may ship the end of the second business day.

Backorders

If an item you purchased is backordered, we will notify you via phone or email. Your order may not ship until the backordered item is available.

Freight Deliveries

Large orders (over 150 pounds) are generally shipped via freight truck on a pallet. We will find the most cost-effective way to ship your order and give you an estimate prior to shipment. Please let us know whether you have a loading dock and/or forklift to unload the pallet(s) from the truck and whether the delivery will be made in a residential or commercial neighborhood. We will also need your receiving hours, the contact person's name and phone number, and if there are any special instructions for the driver. If you require a call ahead and/or an appointment for delivery, there may be an extra charge. For a quote on freight shipments, please call us at 508-821-3704 or email us at sales@baystatepet.com.

International Orders

Our website is set up to handle orders shipped to the U.S. and Canada via FedEx, UPS and USPS (US Postal Service). Please note that all customs, duties, taxes and fees are the responsibility of the customer or receiving party. If you would like to ship to any other country, please call us at 508-821-3704 or email us at info@baystatepet.com and we will give you a quote on shipping. We do not accept credit card payments from countries other than the United States and Canada. International payments may be made via Paypal or wire transfer. All payments must be made in U.S. Dollars. If you have any questions, please call 508-821-3704 or email us at sales@baystatepet.com.

Reliable Residential Heating Pellets for Your Home

If you’re searching for wood pellet fuel in Southeastern New England, we are your trusted local supplier for clean, efficient, and dependable wood pellets. Our pellets are designed specifically for home heating, helping homeowners stay warm and comfortable throughout the Massachusetts winter.

records.text3:
Premium Wood Pellets for Pellet Stoves & Home Heating

We carry multiple brands of wood pellets that are manufactured to strict quality standards, ensuring consistent performance in pellet stoves, pellet boilers, and home furnaces.

 

Why homeowners choose our pellets:

  • High BTU output for steady, reliable heat

  • Low moisture content for efficient burns

  • Low ash for easier stove maintenance

  • Consistent pellet size to prevent feeding issues

  • Cleaner burns than traditional firewood

Perfect for everyday home heating during cold New England winters.

A Cost-Effective Heating Solution for Massachusetts Homes

Wood pellet fuel is a popular choice for homeowners in looking to reduce heating costs while maintaining comfort. Compared to oil, propane, or electric heat, wood pellets offer:

  • More predictable heating costs

  • Improved energy efficiency

  • Reduced reliance on fossil fuels

  • A renewable, environmentally responsible fuel source

Heating your home with pellets is a smart and sustainable option for Massachusetts residents.

Clean-Burning Pellets with Less Maintenance

Our pellets are kiln-dried and screened to reduce dust and fines. This means:

  • Less ash buildup

  • Cleaner pellet stove glass

  • Fewer clogs and shutdowns

  • Less time spent cleaning your stove

 

Wood Pellet Pickup & Delivery

 

Delivery is available to all of Southeastern New England, Minimum order quantity for delivery is 1 ton. A delivery charge will be added to delivery orders based on the zip code where the delivery is to be made and its distance from our Taunton, MA facility. 

Deliveries are made with either a flatbed truck and forklift or a box truck with a lift gate. If you would like your wood pellets placed inside of your garage at the time of delivery we offer a in-garage delivery service that can be ordered at the time of purchase, for a small additional charge the driver will place your pallets inside of your garage.

Please ensure that the location where delivery is to be made is suitable for our equipment, if the driver is unable to place pallets at the requested location due to space or safety limitations, they will be left at the closest possible location to that point.

Learn more about our wood pellet delivery here

 

We offer convenient options for homeowners throughout New England:

Not sure how many pellets you need for the winter? Our team can help estimate the right amount based on your home size and stove type.

Buy Wood Pellets Near You in Taunton, MA

Prepare your home for winter with high-quality pellet fuel from Bay State Pet & Garden Supply.

Serving: Taunton, MA & surrounding Bristol County communities

 

Anthracite Coal

Frequently Asked Questions – Wood Pellets in Taunton, MA

 

How many wood pellets does a typical home need for winter?

Most homes in Massachusetts use 2–4 tons of wood pellets per heating season, depending on home size, insulation, and pellet stove usage.

Are your pellets compatible with all pellet stoves?

Yes. Our wood pellets are compatible with most pellet stoves, pellet boilers, and residential heating systems. Always check your stove manufacturer’s recommendations.

Do you offer wood pellet delivery in Taunton, MA?

Yes, we offer local residential delivery to Southern New England, delivery orders can be placed right from our website.

Are wood pellets better than firewood for home heating?

Wood pellets burn cleaner, produce less ash, and provide more consistent heat than traditional firewood. They’re also easier to store and handle for many homeowners.

When should I buy wood pellets in Massachusetts?

It’s best to purchase pellets late summer or early fall to ensure availability and avoid peak winter demand. Buying by the pallet can also save money.

Are wood pellets environmentally friendly?

Yes. Wood pellets are made from renewable wood sources and produce fewer emissions than many fossil fuels, making them a responsible home heating choice.

Aerator - This is an easy to use, self-propelled lawn aerator. Dethatcher - Thatch is decomposing debris that lays on the surface of the soil below the grass line and for the most part - out of sight. The accumulation of thatch can prevent you lawn from growing to its full lush potential. Dethatching essentially combs out the layer of thatch so it can be removed from the lawn. Our dethatching machine tears away the thatch layer and brings the organic matter to the surface so it can be hand-raked off the lawn.

 

Rototiller - Our rear tine tiller is ideal for homeowners preparing large flowerbeds and vegetable gardens. Its counter-rotating tines allow deep soil penetration for better bed preparation. Forward and reverse gears for improved maneuverability. Can be used for loosening sod in lawns prior to enlarging an existing garden or creating a new one. Rototillers are an invaluable method of turning soil under quickly. They eliminate the need for spade digging, or hoeing, and are useful in keeping pathways between rows of plants clear during the growing season.

First, you ensure your lawns stay thick and dense. Second, the new varieties of seed you sow may have better disease resistance than those varieties already in your lawns. Overseeding also makes it much harder for weeds to become established and compensates for the natural slowdown of the turf’s reproduction over time or during droughts.

Propane Safety

Tanks

  • Propane tanks cannot be brought inside the store.
  • Bay State Pet & Garden Supply inspects all tanks for certification date and condition before refilling. There are rules and guidelines for how long a tank can be re-filled.
  • A tank that is uncertified, damaged, has a bent or missing collar or foot ring, excessive rust or has been painted violates all national propane rules and policies and will not be filled.
  • All barbecue-type cylinders must be equipped with an overfill prevention device (OPD valve). Cylinders older than 12 years (10 years in Canada) must be re-qualified before they can be filled.
  • If you do not have an acceptable propane tank, we have propane tanks that we can sell you to replace your damaged tank.
  • Check your propane cylinder for leaks before you turn on your grill or appliance. The unintentional discharge of propane can cause a flammable environment. Use a solution of soapy water to check for leaks, which will cause bubbles to form. If a leak is found, turn the valve off, and check the system.
  • The distinct odor of rotten eggs is an indicator of a propane leak. Remove any source of flame from the area, and repair or replace any defective parts.

Transporting Home

  • Always keep your propane tanks upright and secure when transporting.
  • If your tank is left or stored in your vehicle, heat, sunlight and motion can increase pressure to an unsafe level. This may cause the safety valve to vent propane gas and create a flammable, explosive environment. Please remove your tank from your vehicle as soon as you return home or to your place of business.
  • Regulations require that all tanks be transported upright and secure with the valve closed. When on its side, a tank's relief valve may open, allowing flammable gas to escape. Contact your local fire department for local rules and regulations.
  • Store and use propane cylinders only in well-ventilated areas.
  • Do not use or inspect a propane cylinder indoors.

While at the Store

  • Bring tank to porch for inspection. See a team member inside for assistance where they will check your tank's date and condition before payment.Please do not bring your tank inside the store.
  • After tank inspection, your tank should remain inside your vehicle or be placed outside the gate near the dispensing station.
  • Have load ticket ready to show team member.
  • Drive or walk right up to the dispensing station where we fill tanks.
  • Team member will open the gate and begin to fill your tank.
  • Remain 25 ft. from the dispensing station. If you are filling a motor home or camper, it must be unoccupied during the refilling process.
  • Follow any additional instructions from the team member.

records.text1:
Here are some of the popular breeds that we offer -

 

Araucana 

The Araucana is a breed of domestic chicken from Chile. Its name derives from the Araucania region of Chile where it is believed to have originated. It lays blue-shelled eggs, one of very few breeds that do so.

Breed standards for the Araucana vary from country to country. It may have unusual tufts of feathers on the ears, and may be rumples, without a tail and tail-bone; in the United States it may for this reason be known as the South American Rumpless. Both ear-tufts and rumplessness are caused by lethal genes, so not all birds display these traits. The Ameraucana breed and "Easter-Egger" hybrids of the United States, which also lay blue or green eggs, both derive from the Araucana.

Poultry Show Class: No Show Class at this time

  • Weights: Hen -------5 1/2 lbs        Rooster----6 1/2 lbs
                        Pullet------4 1/2 lbs       Cockerel---5 1/2 lbs                   
  • Purpose: Egg production and ornamental
  • Egg Shell Color: Blue/Green
  • Egg Production: 200-280 eggs per year (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio: 10 Females to 1 Male
  • Roost Height: 4 to 6 feet
  • Country of Origin: Chile 

 Barred Rock

Recognized by the American Standard of Perfection as a distinct pure chicken breed in 1874 and known as "the kind of chickens that "Grandma use to raise." This is one of the color varieties of the Plymouth Rock chicken family and an excellent winter/summer brown egg layer. The Barred Standard Plymouth Rock Chicken is a great back yard poultry for production and very kid friendly chicken. Most people call these "Barred Rocks” which is a short name for the Barred Plymouth Rock chicken. Some people confuse the Barred Rock chicken with the Dominique chicken breed. The Barred Rock has a single comb (straight comb) and has more of a straight pattern in the barred feathers. The Dominique chicken has a rose comb and a slight v pattern in the barring of the feathers. Both make for good chickens in the winter and good pet chickens.

Poultry Show Class:  American Class

  • Weights: Hen-----7 1/2 lbs        Rooster------9 1/2 lbs
                        Pullet---6 lbs               Cockerel----8 lbs
  • Purpose: Dual Purpose: egg laying and meat production
  • Egg Shell Color: Brown
  • Egg Production: 200 - 280 eggs per year (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio: 10 Females to 1 Male
  • Roost Height: 2 to 4 feet
  • Country of Origin: United States

Black Sex Link

The Sex Link Hybrid is the result of crossing two heritage purebred poultry standard chicken breeds together. They take a Rhode Island Red chicken rooster and a Barred Rock chicken hen and cross them to give you this outstanding brown egg laying hen offspring. The baby chicks for sale from this original cross are color sexable chicks- the grown roosters have faded barred with light colored neck hackle feathers, grown pullets or hens are black with red mixed in their neck hackle feathers. This hybrid chicken breed makes for very vigorous chicks, rugged brown egg laying hens and good cockerel chicken fryers. Although not a show chicken, they are great for raising hens for eggs and pet chickens for the backyard or farm. Many customers like the Black Sex Link chicken for raising free range chicken eggs or organic free range chickens.

Poultry Show Class: No official Show Class at this time

  • Weights: Hen-----6-7 lbs        Rooster------8-9 lbs
                        Pullet---6 lbs            Cockerel----8 lbs
  • Purpose: Dual Purpose, egg laying and meat production
  • Egg Shell Color: Light Brown
  • Egg Production: 200 - 280  eggs per year (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio: 10 Females to 1 Male
  • Roost Height: 2 to 4 feet
  • Country of Origin: United States

 Buff Orpington

Buff Orpington chickens originated in England, and were recognized by the APA as a pure chicken breed in 1902. These "Golden Chicken Beauties" are a large, stately chicken with a quiet disposition. Buff Orpington chickens are one of the best chickens for eggs and for meat. They are white skinned, plump, and juicy for a great dressed out chicken. The Buff Orpington is one of the best chickens for sale online for dual egg and meat purposes. Many will put their 2 year old chickens in the stew pot and retain the 1 year old hens for laying eggs.  This accomplishes the most efficient cost to feed ratio to raise chickens. Most chicken breed charts will list the Buff Orpington chicken as a dual purpose bird that lay a medium brown egg. Even though the Buff Orpington chicken is a very heavy and large bird, this does not always mean the bigger the hen the larger the egg. Buff Orpingtons make excellent broody mothers for baby chicks.

 

Poultry Show Class: English Class

  • Weights: Hen-----8 lbs         Rooster------10 lbs
                        Pullet---7 lbs         Cockerel----8 1/2 lbs
  • Purpose: Dual Purpose, egg laying and meat production
  • Egg Shell Color: Brown
  • Egg Production: 200-280 eggs per year (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio: 9 Females to 1 Male
  • Roost Height: 2 to 4 feet
  • Country of Origin: England

 Golden Comet

The Golden Comet chickens are known for their fast body development, fast egg production and rich brown egg shell color. The parent stock is made from a strain of the Cherry Egger male and the Rhode Island White female. 

This strain will start to lay eggs at a younger age than most standard breeds and produce large to extra large brown eggs. They are also color sexable as chicks for the first generation which are the chicks you receive. Chicks from the second generation will not be color sexable and will come in multiple colors. As chicks the cockerels are white and the pullets are more brownish red in color. Leg color is mostly yellow but will get some greenish. Hens feathering color varies with brownish feathers and white feathers. Adult rooster feathering color varies from totally white to white with light to dark red feathers on shoulder feathers.

Poultry Show Class: No official Show Class at this time

  • Weights - Hen-----6-7 lbs      Rooster------8-9 lbs
                         Pullet----6 lbs        Cockerel-----8 lbs
  • Purpose - Dual Purpose: egg laying and meat production
  • Egg Shell Color - Brown
  • Egg Production - Good, 250-320 eggs per year  (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio:  10 Females to 1 Male
  • Roost Height:   2 to 4 feet
  • Country of Origin - United States

Rhode Island Red

Originated in Rhode Island, it is the state bird of Rhode Island and recognized as a distinct pure chicken breed in 1904 by the American Standard of Perfection. The Single Comb Rhode Island Red chicken is our most popular breed for brown egg laying production. They are a popular chicken choice for backyard chicken flocks because of their egg laying abilities and hardiness. Rhode Island Red chicks are a good choice for raising baby chickens naturally and raising baby chickens for eggs. Non-industrial strains of the Rhode Island Red are listed as recovering by the American Livestock Breeds Conservancy.  The Rhode Island Red is a true heritage chicken breed picked as a great choice for egg production. Many breeders breed the Rhode Island Red chicken for show, these are a little darker red and do not produce as many eggs. The Roosters usually weigh in at 8.5 pounds (3.9 kg), The Hens weigh slightly less at 6.5 pounds (2.9 kg), cockerel at 7.5 pounds (3.4 kg), and pullets at 5.5 pounds (2.5 kg). Developed in Rhode Island and Massachusetts, early flocks often had both single and rose combed individuals because of the influence of Malay blood.

Poultry Show Class: American Class 

  • Weights: Hen-----6 1/2 lbs     Rooster------8 1/2 lbs
                        Pullet--5 1/2 lbs       Cockerel-----7 1/2 lbs
  • Purpose: Dual Purpose: egg laying and meat production
  • Egg Shell Color: Brown
  • Egg Production: 200-280 eggs per year (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio: 10 Females to 1 Males
  • Roost Height: 2 to 4 feet
  • Country of Origin: United States, Rhode Island

 Silver Laced Wyandotte

Admitted to the American Standard of Perfection in 1883. These originated in New York State and are the parent variety of the all of the other Wyandottes. The Black Laced Silver Wyandotte chickens are a docile bird with clean legs and mostly black laced silvery white feathers and black tail. They have a red rose comb, earlobes and wattles. They will on occasion go broody and they make excellent mothers. They work well in confinement or free range and are a great back yard chicken.

 White Leghorn

White Leghorns are good layers of white eggs, laying an average of 280 per year and sometimes reaching 300–320. They were admitted to the American Standard of Perfection in 1874 and originates from Italy, Denmark, and England. This breed is very athletic, hardy, non-sitters and lay very nice large/X large white eggs. They have a good feed-to-egg conversion ratio, needing around 125 grams per day of feed. This chicken breed is great for free range chicken farming or organic free range chicken eggs.  Leghorns rarely exhibit broodiness and are thus well suited for uninterrupted egg laying. The Leghorn is a light breed that matures quickly and is not considered a viable meat producer. Leghorns are active and efficient foragers and are one of the best for free range chickens that can avoid predators. However, the white variety of the leghorn might be easily seen by predators. They typically avoid human contact and tend to be nervous and flighty.

  • Egg Production: 220-300 eggs per year (estimate only)
  • Mating Ratio: 12 Females to 1 Male
  • Roost Height: 4 to 8 feet
  • Country of Origin: Italy

White Rock

The White Plymouth Rock chicken was recognized as a distinct chicken breed and admitted to the American Standard of Perfection as a pure breed chicken in 1888. The White Plymouth Rock chicken is a good dual purpose chicken, a good pet chicken, a member of the Plymouth Rock family and known by their short name as a white rock chicken. A great American poultry heritage chicken breed that grandma and grandpa would have on the farm. They lay large to extra large brown eggs and the cockerels make very good fryers. White Rocks hens have similar characteristics as the Barred Rocks, except they are pure white in color. As chicks, however the chick fuzz can be white to all shades of dark smoky color turning to white feathers as new juvenile feathers emerge. As adults they will have yellow legs, however as young chicks and juvenile chickens some will have darker leg color. They are graceful, inquisitive, friendly and easy to manage. White Rocks hens are not as popular as the Barred Rocks, they have soft feathers and a dawn like undercoat, making them very cold hardy. White Rocks are great chickens to have in a backyard flock. White Rocks hens start laying eggs on average at about 5 months after hatching and are among some of the earliest maturing laying hens. White Rock hens, like most laying hens, will go through a period of chicken feather molting, usually after laying for several months. During the molting period the hens won't lay eggs and their pelvic bones will become not as wide. They may lose feathers and get pretty rough looking. Their faces will turn from a bright red to a pale pinkish color and it may take several weeks (4-8 weeks) to be done with the molting. When their face, comb and wattles become red again and the hens begin to sing you will know they are about to resume laying eggs. The White Rock chicken continues to be used as the female breeding side of the commercial Cornish Broiler Cross chicken.

The Holiday Shoppe at Bay State Pet & Garden Supply

Nothing compares to the magic of the holiday season here at Bay State! Starting the week before Thanksgiving, the store is full of thousands of Christmas Trees, Wreaths and Holiday Decor!. While the many different trees and decorations showcase the beauty of the Christmas season, the best part is spending it with family, friends and loved ones, Picking out your Christmas Tree is a time honored tradition and we are incredibly grateful to be a place where families can come to create cherished memories, our favorite part of the season is seeing people come visit us and have a great time choosing their tree.

“The best part about this time of year is seeing families come in to pick out their trees together, especially when the little ones get excited about finding the perfect tree, it gives you a real sense of pride in what you do.” - Jack Reposa, Assistant Manager

Premium Christmas Trees

Our selection boasts lush, vibrant, fresh cut Fraser and Balsam Fir trees. With sizes ranging from two feet to over 15 feet tall, you are sure to find the perfect tree for your home! Live potted Christmas Trees are also available so you can enjoy them long after the holiday season!

“Our family loves the Christmas trees from Bay State. Decorating for the holidays has become a treasured family tradition." 

Our outstanding team will cut & wrap your tree, and load it into/onto your car! If you would like us to do the heavy lifting, we can deliver your tree straight to your home!

 

Handcrafted Wreaths 

In addition to our Christmas Trees, we have beautiful handmade wreaths decorated by our team, each wreath is a unique piece designed to add elegance to your holiday decor!

"The wreaths are stunning. They add the perfect touch to my home’s festive decor."

Other Holiday Decor

Hanging baskets, porch pots, garland, roping, and branches/boughs create the perfect decorations for this joyful season!

Nationwide Shipping: For those customers who are not able to come visit us in person we offer nationwide shipping on our wreaths, swags and garlands. No matter where you are located we want to bring the fragrance and beauty of the season to your home!

 

Whether you have been shopping with us for years or have never even been into the store, we invite you to visit and enjoy the Christmas season with us, we look forward to seeing you!

 

Wholesale Christmas Trees, Wreaths & Decor

 

We are proud to supply businesses with all of their holiday decor needs. Some examples of our wholesale customers include: Roadside Farm Stands, Seasonal Christmas Tree Lots, Gift Shops, Garden Centers/Nurseries, and Landscape Contractors. If you would like more information about our wholesale services please email Jack at jack@baystatepet.com.


Christmas Tree FAQs

“What is the difference between Fraser and Balsam Christmas Trees?”

There are two main differences between Fraser and Balsam Christmas Trees

Needle retention: Balsam Fir trees tend to shed more needles than Fraser Fir, this does not mean the tree won’t last as long, it is simply a natural habit of the species. If you prefer a little bit less cleanup, Fraser Fir may be the right choice for you.

Fragrance: Balsam Fir trees have a stronger scent than Fraser Fir when they are displayed in your home, if you are someone who likes the house to have a nice aroma during the holidays, Balsam may be right for you.

 

“How long do your trees last?”

The short answer to this question is that your tree should be soft and green until New Years. Our trees are cut very close to their ship date, the fresher the tree is, the longer it should last. Water is always your friend, keep your tree stand full of water and do not let it dry out. Through the day your tree will drink water and you will need to add more. We recommend checking the water level with your finger in the morning and the evening.

Locally grown plants experience less shipping stress, making them stronger and more attractive than plants that have spent days on trucks.

Arrange mums on either side of your front door with pumpkins and lanterns for a classic New England look.

Many customers enjoy using gourds indoors as table centerpieces or outdoors around landscaping.

 

 

Corn Stalks

Corn stalk bundles remain one of the most popular fall decorating items.

Tie them around porch posts, lamp posts, mailboxes, fences, or business entrances for an authentic harvest look.

Combined with straw bales and pumpkins, corn stalks instantly transform your home for autumn.

  • Decorate businesses

Fall Porch Decorating Ideas
